PROCEDURE populate_drives_info_rg IS
 id_rg RecordGroup;
 id_gc GroupColumn;
 h_group_row_count number;
 h_tmp_code varchar2(10);
 h_tmp_description varchar2(50);
 h_tmp_hidden_code varchar2(10);
 curr_group_row number;
 h_columns varchar2(1000);
 h_from varchar2(1000);
 h_where_clause varchar2(32000);
 h_having varchar2(1000);
 h_order_by varchar2(200); -- Added by Kishore on 09/09/2014. SCR 20768
 h_need_sponsors boolean := FALSE; -- if we need to check sponsors and drive_sponsors
 h_need_category boolean := FALSE; -- if we need to check valid_master_codes for category
 h_need_status boolean := FALSE; -- if we need to check valid_master_codes for drive status
 h_need_territory boolean := FALSE; -- if we need to check valid_master_codes for territory
 h_need_proc_code boolean := FALSE; -- if we need to check valid_master_codes for procedure code
 h_need_zip_code boolean := FALSE; -- if we need to check against zip codes for drive location
 h_need_drv_cat boolean := FALSE; -- if we need to check valid_master_codes for drive category
 h_list_count number := 0;
 h_tmp_in_string varchar2(200);
 h_query varchar2(32000);
 h_english_query varchar2(32000);
 h_rtn_value number;
 v_min_starttime date;
 v_max_endtime date;
 v_min_durtime date;
 v_max_durtime date;
 v_gmt_time date;
 gmt_min_duration date;
 gmt_max_duration date;
 gmt_min_start date;
 gmt_max_end date;

BEGIN
 validate(item_scope); --when-validate-item must fire for some fields
 clear_message;
 message('Validating search criteria....', no_acknowledge);
 --pitss synchronize;

 if :ctrl_block.start_date is null then
 :ctrl_block.start_date := sysdate;
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 if :ctrl_block.end_date is null then
 show_error('11067');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 execute_trigger('validate_dates');
 if not form_success then
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 /*
 if (:min_proj_draw is null and :max_proj_draw is not null) or
 (:max_proj_draw is null and :min_proj_draw is not null) then
 show_error('11283') ;
 check_package_failure ;
 end if ;
 if (:min_travel_time is null and :max_travel_time is not null) or
 (:max_travel_time is null and :min_travel_time is not null) then
 show_error('11284') ;
 check_package_failure ;
 end if ;
 if (:min_duration is null and :max_duration is not null) or
 (:max_duration is null and :min_duration is not null) then
 show_error('11285') ;
 check_package_failure ;
 end if ;
 */

 set_application_property(CURSOR_STYLE,'BUSY'); /* Added by Lakshmi. 01/29/98 */

 clear_message;
 message('Validating selection criteria....', no_acknowledge);
 --pitss synchronize;

 if :ctrl_block.drive_status is null and
 get_list_element_count('ctrl_block.drive_status_list') <= 1 then
 h_need_status := FALSE;
 else
 h_need_status := TRUE;
 end if;

 if :ctrl_block.sponsor_id is null and
 get_list_element_count('ctrl_block.sponsors_list') <= 1 then
 h_need_sponsors := FALSE;
 else
 h_need_sponsors := TRUE;
 end if;

 if :ctrl_block.sponsor_category is null and
 get_list_element_count('ctrl_block.sponsor_category_list') <= 1 then
 h_need_category := FALSE;
 else
 h_need_category := TRUE;
 end if;

 if :ctrl_block.territory_id is null and
 get_list_element_count('ctrl_block.territory_list') <= 1 then
 h_need_territory := FALSE;
 else
 h_need_territory := TRUE;
 end if;

 if :ctrl_block.zip_code is null and
 get_list_element_count('ctrl_block.zip_code_list') <= 1 then
 h_need_zip_code := FALSE;
 else
 h_need_zip_code := TRUE;
 end if;

 if :ctrl_block.drive_category is null and
 get_list_element_count('ctrl_block.drive_category_list') <= 1 then
 h_need_drv_cat := FALSE;
 else
 h_need_drv_cat := TRUE;
 end if;

 if :ctrl_block.procedure_code is null and
 get_list_element_count('ctrl_block.procedure_code_list') <= 1 then
 h_need_proc_code := FALSE;
 else
 h_need_proc_code := TRUE;
 end if;

 /*
 ** assumptions
 ** drive_date and drive_id is always selected from drives table
 ** sponsor_id is retrieved from sponsors table and thru drive_sponsors table.
 */

 clear_message;
 message('Forming query.....', no_acknowledge);
 --pitss synchronize;

 h_columns := 'select drives.drive_date,drives.drive_id,min(sponsors.sponsor_id) sponsor_id,min(sponsors.name) name,'||
 'sum(drive_sponsors.projected_draw) projected_draw,sum(drive_sponsors.projected_show) projected_show,'||
 'drives.recruiter_id,drives.schedule_end_time,drives.schedule_start_time,locations.travel_time';
 :ctrl_block.formatted_query := 'Retrieve Drive Date, Drive ID, Piggyback Status, Sponsor name,'|| new_line ||
 'Travel Time, Duration, Drive Status, Recruiter,'|| new_line ||
 'Projected Show, Projected Draw'|| new_line;
 :ctrl_block.formatted_query := :ctrl_block.formatted_query || 'for following criteria.... '|| new_line;
 :ctrl_block.formatted_query := :ctrl_block.formatted_query || 'Drive Date Between '||
 initcap(to_char(:ctrl_block.start_date, 'DY MON DD, YYYY'))||
 ' and ' ||
 initcap(to_char(:ctrl_block.end_date, 'DY MON DD, YYYY'))|| new_line;

 h_from := 'drives, drive_sponsors, sponsors, locations';

 -- 1. filter thru drive dates
 h_where_clause := 'drives.drive_date between '||
 'to_date('||in_quotes(to_char(:ctrl_block.start_date,'mmddyyyy'))||','||in_quotes('mmddyyyy')||') and '||
 'to_date('||in_quotes(to_char(:ctrl_block.end_date, 'mmddyyyy'))||','||in_quotes('mmddyyyy')||') and '||
 'drive_sponsors.drive_id = drives.drive_id and '||
 'sponsors.sponsor_id = drive_sponsors.sponsor_id and '||
 'locations.location_id = drives.location_id';

 -- 2. deal with drive_status if specified
 if h_need_status and :ctrl_block.check_status != 'NONE' then
 if :ctrl_block.check_status = 'SINGLE' then
 -- set where clause
 h_where_clause := h_where_clause||' and drives.status = '||in_quotes(:ctrl_block.drive_status);
 :ctrl_block.formatted_query := :ctrl_block.formatted_query||'Drive Status is '||in_quotes(:ctrl_block.drive_status_desc)||new_line;
 elsif :ctrl_block.check_status = 'MULTI' then
 get_in_string('ctrl_block.drive_status_list', h_tmp_in_string);
 h_where_clause := h_where_clause||' and drives.status in '||h_tmp_in_string;
 :ctrl_block.formatted_query := :ctrl_block.formatted_query||
 'Drive Status either ' || rtrim(ltrim(replace(h_tmp_in_string, ', ', ' or '), '('), ')') || new_line;
 end if;
 end if;


 -- 21...see if Facility is specified.... (Added by Dinesh dated 06/01/98 
 if :ctrl_block.facility is not null then 
 h_where_clause := h_where_clause || ' and drives.drive_id in (select drive_id from drive_facilities where facility_code = :ctrl_block.facility)' ; 
 end if ;

 -- 3. see if sponsors is specified
 if h_need_sponsors and :ctrl_block.check_sponsors != 'NONE' then
 if :ctrl_block.check_sponsors = 'SINGLE' then
 -- set where clause
 h_where_clause := h_where_clause || ' and drive_sponsors.sponsor_id = ' || in_quotes(:ctrl_block.sponsor_id);
 :ctrl_block.formatted_query := :ctrl_block.formatted_query || 'Drive Sponsor is ' || in_quotes(:ctrl_block.sponsor_name) || new_line;
 elsif :ctrl_block.check_sponsors = 'MULTI' then
 get_in_string('ctrl_block.sponsors_list', h_tmp_in_string);
 h_where_clause := h_where_clause || ' and drive_sponsors.sponsor_id in ' || h_tmp_in_string;
 :ctrl_block.formatted_query := :ctrl_block.formatted_query ||
 'Drive Sponsor either ' || rtrim(ltrim(replace(h_tmp_in_string, ', ', ' or '), '('), ')') || new_line;

 end if;
 elsif h_need_category or h_need_territory then
 -- 3.1 deal with sponsor category
 if h_need_category and :ctrl_block.check_category != 'NONE' then
 if :ctrl_block.check_category = 'SINGLE' then
 -- set where clause
 h_where_clause := h_where_clause || ' and sponsors.category = ' || in_quotes(:ctrl_block.sponsor_category);
 :ctrl_block.formatted_query := :ctrl_block.formatted_query || 'Sponsor Category is ' ||
 in_quotes(:ctrl_block.sponsor_category_description) || new_line;
 elsif :ctrl_block.check_category = 'MULTI' then
 get_in_string('ctrl_block.sponsor_category_list', h_tmp_in_string);
 h_where_clause := h_where_clause || ' and sponsors.category in ' || h_tmp_in_string;
 :ctrl_block.formatted_query := :ctrl_block.formatted_query ||
 'Sponsor Category either ' || rtrim(ltrim(replace(h_tmp_in_string, ', ', ' or '), '('), ')') || new_line;

 end if;
 end if;

 -- 3.2 deal with sponsor territory
 if h_need_territory and :ctrl_block.check_territory != 'NONE' then
 if :ctrl_block.check_territory = 'SINGLE' then
 -- set where clause
 h_where_clause := h_where_clause || ' and sponsors.territory_id = ' || in_quotes(:ctrl_block.territory_id);
 :ctrl_block.formatted_query := :ctrl_block.formatted_query || 'Sponsor Territory is ' || in_quotes(:ctrl_block.territory_name) || new_line;
 elsif :ctrl_block.check_territory = 'MULTI' then
 get_in_string('ctrl_block.territory_list', h_tmp_in_string);
 h_where_clause := h_where_clause || ' and sponsors.territory_id in ' || h_tmp_in_string;
 :ctrl_block.formatted_query := :ctrl_block.formatted_query ||
 'Sponsor Territory either ' || rtrim(ltrim(replace(h_tmp_in_string, ', ', ' or '), '('), ')') || new_line;
 end if;
 end if;
 end if;

 -- 4. deal with drive location zip codes if specified
 if h_need_zip_code and :ctrl_block.check_zip_code != 'NONE' then
 if :ctrl_block.check_zip_code = 'SINGLE' then
 -- set from clause
 h_from := h_from || ', addresses, valid_city_state';
 -- set where clause
 h_where_clause := h_where_clause ||
 ' and addresses.address_id = locations.address_id ' ||
 ' and valid_city_state.usps_id = addresses.usps_id ' || 
 ' and valid_city_state.zip = ' || in_quotes(:ctrl_block.zip_code);
 :ctrl_block.formatted_query := :ctrl_block.formatted_query || 'Drive Location is ' || in_quotes(:ctrl_block.zip_city || ' [' || :ctrl_block.zip_code || '] ') || new_line;
 elsif :ctrl_block.check_zip_code = 'MULTI' then
 get_in_string('ctrl_block.zip_code_list', h_tmp_in_string);
 -- set from clause
 h_from := h_from || ', addresses, valid_city_state';
 h_where_clause := h_where_clause ||
 ' and addresses.address_id = locations.address_id ' ||
 ' and valid_city_state.usps_id = addresses.usps_id ' || 
 ' and valid_city_state.zip in ' || h_tmp_in_string;
 :ctrl_block.formatted_query := :ctrl_block.formatted_query ||
 'Drive Location Zip Code either ' || rtrim(ltrim(replace(h_tmp_in_string, ', ', ' or '), '('), ')') || new_line;
 end if;
 end if;

 -- 5. deal with drive procedure codes if specified
 if h_need_proc_code and :ctrl_block.check_proc_code != 'NONE' then
 if :ctrl_block.check_proc_code = 'SINGLE' then
 h_from := h_from || ', drive_procedures';
 -- set where clause
 h_where_clause := h_where_clause || ' and drive_procedures.drive_id = drives.drive_id and drive_procedures.procedure_code = ' || in_quotes(:ctrl_block.procedure_code);
 :ctrl_block.formatted_query := :ctrl_block.formatted_query || 'Procedure in the drive is ' || in_quotes(:ctrl_block.procedure_code_description) || new_line;
 elsif :ctrl_block.check_proc_code = 'MULTI' then
 h_from := h_from || ', drive_procedures';
 get_in_string('ctrl_block.procedure_code_list', h_tmp_in_string);
 h_where_clause := h_where_clause || ' and drive_procedures.drive_id = drives.drive_id and drive_procedures.procedure_code in ' || h_tmp_in_string;
 :ctrl_block.formatted_query := :ctrl_block.formatted_query ||
 'Drive Procedures either ' || rtrim(ltrim(replace(h_tmp_in_string, ', ', ' or '), '('), ')') || new_line;
 end if;
 end if;

 -- 6. deal with drive_category if specified
 if h_need_drv_cat and :ctrl_block.check_drv_category != 'NONE' then
 if :ctrl_block.check_drv_category = 'SINGLE' then
 -- set where clause
 h_where_clause := h_where_clause || ' and drives.drive_category = ' || in_quotes(:ctrl_block.drive_category);
 :ctrl_block.formatted_query := :ctrl_block.formatted_query || 'Drive Category is ' || in_quotes(:ctrl_block.drive_category_desc) || new_line;
 elsif :ctrl_block.check_drv_category = 'MULTI' then
 get_in_string('ctrl_block.drive_category_list', h_tmp_in_string);
 h_where_clause := h_where_clause || ' and drives.drive_category in ' || h_tmp_in_string;
 :ctrl_block.formatted_query := :ctrl_block.formatted_query ||
 'Drive Category either ' || rtrim(ltrim(replace(h_tmp_in_string, ', ', ' or '), '('), ')') || new_line;
 end if;
 end if;

 -- 7. check for inclusion of fixed
 /*------------ Code added by Edwin 02-1-97 ---------*/
 if :ctrl_block.s_fixed = 'I' then /*-- Include Fixed drives --*/
 :ctrl_block.formatted_query := :ctrl_block.formatted_query || 'Include Fixed Drives... ' || new_line;
 elsif :ctrl_block.s_fixed = 'E' then /*-- Exclude fixed drives --*/
 h_where_clause := h_where_clause || ' and nvl(drives.drive_type,'||in_quotes('*')||') != ' || in_quotes('F');
 :ctrl_block.formatted_query := :ctrl_block.formatted_query || 'Do Not Include Fixed Drives... ' || new_line;
 elsif :ctrl_block.s_fixed = 'O' then /*-- Only rollovers --*/
 h_where_clause := h_where_clause || ' and nvl(drives.drive_type,'||in_quotes('*')||') = ' || in_quotes('F');
 :ctrl_block.formatted_query := :ctrl_block.formatted_query || 'Show only Fixed Drives... ' || new_line;
 end if;

 -- 8. check for rollover status of the drives
 /*------------ Code added by Nabendu 12-1-97 ---------*/
 if :ctrl_block.ck_rollover = 'I' then /*-- Include rollovers --*/
 :ctrl_block.formatted_query := :ctrl_block.formatted_query || 'Include Rollover Drives... ' || new_line;
 elsif :ctrl_block.ck_rollover = 'E' then /*-- Exclude rollovers --*/
 h_where_clause := h_where_clause || ' and nvl(drives.rollover_status,'||in_quotes('*')||') != ' || in_quotes('Y');
 :ctrl_block.formatted_query := :ctrl_block.formatted_query || 'Do Not Include Rollover Drives... ' || new_line;
 elsif :ctrl_block.ck_rollover = 'O' then /*-- Only rollovers --*/
 h_where_clause := h_where_clause || ' and nvl(drives.rollover_status,'||in_quotes('*')||') = ' || in_quotes('Y');
 :ctrl_block.formatted_query := :ctrl_block.formatted_query || 'Show only Rollover Drives... ' || new_line;
 end if;

 -- 9. check projected draw
 if :ctrl_block.min_proj_draw is not null and
 :ctrl_block.max_proj_draw is not null then

 'Drive Projected Draw less than '|| to_char(:ctrl_block.max_proj_draw) || new_line;
 else

 end if;

 -- 10. check travel time

 -- 11. check drive duration
 
 -- converted local min start time and min end time to GMT timezone.

 v_max_durtime := to_date(to_char(trunc(sysdate),'mm/dd/yyyy') || ' ' || to_char(:ctrl_block.max_duration,'HH24:MI'),'mm/dd/yyyy hh24:mi');

 if :global.is_time_enabled_value ='Y' then

 if :ctrl_block.min_duration is not null and

 h_where_clause := h_where_clause || ' and 24*60*(drives.schedule_end_time-drives.schedule_start_time) '||
 'between '||to_char(24*60*(gmt_min_duration-trunc(gmt_min_duration)))||

 elsif :ctrl_block.min_duration is not null then

 :ctrl_block.formatted_query := :ctrl_block.formatted_query ||

 end if;
 
 -- 12. check drive start, end
 
 v_min_starttime := to_date(to_char(trunc(sysdate),'mm/dd/yyyy') || ' ' || to_char(:ctrl_block.min_start_time,'HH24:MI'),'mm/dd/yyyy hh24:mi');
 v_max_endtime := to_date(to_char(trunc(sysdate),'mm/dd/yyyy') || ' ' || to_char(:ctrl_block.max_end_time,'HH24:MI'),'mm/dd/yyyy hh24:mi');
 
 if :global.is_time_enabled_value ='Y' then

 else

 if :global.is_time_enabled_value ='Y' then

 end if; 
 
 if :ctrl_block.min_start_time is not null and 
 :ctrl_block.max_end_time is not null then
 h_where_clause := h_where_clause || ' and 24*60*(drives.schedule_start_time-trunc(drives.schedule_start_time)) '||
 '>= '||to_char(24*60*(gmt_min_start-trunc(gmt_min_start)));
 h_where_clause := h_where_clause || ' and 24*60*(drives.schedule_end_time-trunc(drives.schedule_end_time)) '||
 '<= '||to_char(24*60*(gmt_max_end-trunc(gmt_max_end)));
 :ctrl_block.formatted_query := :ctrl_block.formatted_query ||
 'Drive Takes Place Between ' || to_char(:ctrl_block.min_start_time, 'HH24:MI') ||
 ' and ' || to_char(:ctrl_block.max_end_time, 'HH24:MI') || new_line;
 elsif :ctrl_block.min_start_time is not null then 
 h_where_clause := h_where_clause || ' and 24*60*(drives.schedule_start_time-trunc(drives.schedule_start_time)) '||
 '>= '||to_char(24*60*(gmt_min_start-trunc(gmt_min_start)));
 :ctrl_block.formatted_query := :ctrl_block.formatted_query ||

 elsif :ctrl_block.max_end_time is not null then

PROCEDURE filter_and_populate_drives (rg_name varchar2, 
 id_rg RecordGroup) IS
 h_group_row_count number;
 h_tmp_code varchar2(10);
 h_tmp_description varchar2(50);
 h_tmp_hidden_code varchar2(10);
 curr_group_row number;
 h_drive_start date;
 h_drive_end date;
 h_drv_status_desc varchar2(50);
 h_drive_date date;
 h_drive_id varchar2(10);
 h_show_this_record boolean := FALSE;
 h_total_records number;
 h_rollover_ind VARCHAR2(1);
 nPiggyCount number;
 c_duration number; /* Added by lakshmi 02/29/97 . To get the duration of drv */

 cursor cur_piggy (p_drive_id varchar2) is
 select count(drive_id)
 from drive_groups
 where drive_group_type = 'PIGGY'
 and drive_group_id = (select drive_group_id
 from drive_groups
 where drive_id = p_drive_id);

 cursor cur_drive_status (p_drive_date date, p_drive_id varchar2) is
 select drives.rollover_status, vmc.description
 from drives , valid_master_codes vmc
 where drives.drive_date = p_drive_date
 and drives.drive_id = p_drive_id
 and vmc.code_type = 'DSTAT'
 and vmc.code = drives.status
 and drives.chapter_id = :global.chapter_id;

 /* Added by Lakshmi 01/29/98 */

 function get_travel_time(c_tr_time number) return VARCHAR2 is

 c_travel_time varchar2(6);
 
 begin
 c_travel_time := lpad(to_char(floor(c_tr_time/60)),2,'0')||':'||
 lpad(to_char(((c_tr_time/60)-floor(c_tr_time/60))*60),2,'0');
 return c_travel_time;
 exception
 when others then
 return NULL;
 end; 

BEGIN
 clear_message;
 message('Retrieving information....', no_acknowledge);
 --pitss synchronize;

 h_group_row_count := get_group_row_count(id_rg);

 go_block('drives_block');
 clear_block(no_validate);
 set_block_property('drives_block', insert_allowed, property_true);
 set_block_property('drives_block', update_allowed, property_true);
 set_block_property('drives_block', delete_allowed, property_false);

 h_total_records := 0;
 for i in 1 .. h_group_row_count
 loop
 h_show_this_record := TRUE;
 /*
 ** check if user has specified proj draw criteria
 */
 h_drive_date := get_group_date_cell('MULTI_SELECT_TMP.DRIVE_DATE', i);
 h_drive_id := get_group_char_cell('MULTI_SELECT_TMP.DRIVE_ID', i);

 /*
 ** if h_show_this_record is true then go ahead and show
 ** else go to next record;
 */
 if h_show_this_record then
 /*
 ** retrieve drive status description
 */
 open cur_drive_status(h_drive_date, h_drive_id);
 fetch cur_drive_status 
 into h_rollover_ind, h_drv_status_desc;
 if cur_drive_status%NOTFOUND then
 close cur_drive_status;
 h_drv_status_desc := 'Not Found.';
 end if;
 if cur_drive_status%ISOPEN then
 close cur_drive_status;
 end if;
 /*
 ** check piggy back status
 */
 open cur_piggy(h_drive_id);
 fetch cur_piggy 
 into nPiggyCount;
 if cur_piggy%NOTFOUND then
 close cur_piggy;
 end if;
 if cur_piggy%ISOPEN then
 close cur_piggy;
 end if;

-- message (to_char(i) || ': ' || to_char(h_drive_date, 'MM-DD-YY') || ' - ' || h_drive_id ||
-- ', ' || h_drv_status_desc, acknowledge);
-- create_record;
 :drives_block.drive_date := get_group_date_cell('MULTI_SELECT_TMP.DRIVE_DATE',i);
 :drives_block.drive_id := get_group_char_cell('MULTI_SELECT_TMP.DRIVE_ID',i);
 if nPiggyCount > 1 then
 :drives_block.piggy_status := 'Y';
 end if;
 :drives_block.sponsor_id := get_group_char_cell('MULTI_SELECT_TMP.SPONSOR_ID',i);
 :drives_block.sponsor_name := initcap(get_group_char_cell('MULTI_SELECT_TMP.NAME',i));
 :drives_block.recruiter_id := get_group_char_cell('MULTI_SELECT_TMP.RECRUITER_ID',i);
 c_duration := (get_group_date_cell('MULTI_SELECT_TMP.SCHEDULE_END_TIME',i) -
 get_group_date_cell('MULTI_SELECT_TMP.SCHEDULE_START_TIME',i))*24;
 :drives_block.duration := lpad(to_char(floor(c_duration)),2,'0')||':'||
 lpad(to_char((c_duration-floor(c_duration))*60),2,'0');
 :drives_block.proj_show := get_group_number_cell('MULTI_SELECT_TMP.PROJECTED_SHOW',i);
 :drives_block.proj_draw := get_group_number_cell('MULTI_SELECT_TMP.PROJECTED_DRAW',i);
 :drives_block.travel_time := get_travel_time(get_group_number_cell('MULTI_SELECT_TMP.TRAVEL_TIME',i));
 if h_rollover_ind = 'Y' then
 :drives_block.drive_status_desc := h_drv_status_desc || '[R]';
 else
 :drives_block.drive_status_desc := h_drv_status_desc;
 end if;
 h_total_records := h_total_records + 1;
 end if;
 if i < h_group_row_count then
 create_record;
 end if;
 end loop;

/* Change By Dinesh Dtd 06/02/98.
 If No of Records retrieved is Zero, then display the message in Alert else display
 as message at bottom of scr.
*/
 set_application_property(CURSOR_STYLE,'DEFAULT'); /* Added by Dinesh. 06/16/98 */

 if h_total_records = 0 then 
 clear_message ;
 declare
 alert_val number ;
 begin 
 set_alert_property('INFORM_ALERT', alert_message_text, 'Your selection criteria retrieved no records!');
 alert_val := show_alert('INFORM_ALERT');
 end ; 
 else
 message('Your selection criteria retrieved ' || to_char(h_total_records) || ' records.', no_acknowledge);
 end if ;

 delete_group(id_rg);
 :global.total_displayed_records := to_char(h_total_records);
 :ctrl_block.total_records := h_total_records;
 redisplay;

 if h_total_records > 0 then
 go_item('drives_block.ck_sel_unsel');
 go_record(1);
--- set_block_property('drives_block', insert_allowed, property_false);
--- set_block_property('drives_block', update_allowed, property_false);
 set_block_property('drives_block', delete_allowed, property_false);
 else
 go_item('ctrl_block.start_date');
 end if;
END;

declare
 v_local_time DATE;
begin
 
 -- Converts GMT date to local date (IM# 5320)
 if :global.is_time_enabled_value = 'Y' then
 lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate, v_local_time);
 else
 v_local_time := sysdate;
 end if;
 --

 if :ctrl_block.drive_selection_flag = 'A' then
 if :ctrl_block.start_date is null then
 :ctrl_block.start_date := trunc(v_local_time); --sysdate;
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 if :ctrl_block.end_date is not null then
 if :ctrl_block.start_date > :ctrl_block.end_date then
 show_error('9192');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
 end if;

 if :ctrl_block.drive_selection_flag = 'P' then
 if :ctrl_block.start_date is null then
 :ctrl_block.start_date := trunc(v_local_time) - 1; --sysdate - 1;
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 elsif :ctrl_block.start_date >= trunc(v_local_time) then --sysdate then
 show_error('11072');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 if :ctrl_block.end_date is not null then
 if :ctrl_block.start_date > :ctrl_block.end_date then
 show_error('9192');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 elsif :ctrl_block.end_date >= trunc(v_local_time) then --sysdate then
 show_error('11072');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
 end if;

 if :ctrl_block.drive_selection_flag = 'F' then
 if :ctrl_block.start_date is null then
 :ctrl_block.start_date := trunc(v_local_time) + 1; --sysdate + 1;
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 elsif :ctrl_block.start_date <= trunc(v_local_time) then --sysdate then
 show_error('11073');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 if :ctrl_block.end_date is not null then
 if :ctrl_block.start_date > :ctrl_block.end_date then
 show_error('9192');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 elsif :ctrl_block.end_date <= trunc(v_local_time) then -- sysdate then
 show_error('11073');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
 end if;

 if :ctrl_block.end_date is null and :system.trigger_item = 'CTRL_BLOCK.END_DATE' then
 show_error('11067');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;

 exception
 when value_error then
 show_error('9191');
 raise form_trigger_failure;

end;
